title: Funk Breakbeat
description: A funk breakbeat in D dorian at 128 BPM, 64 bars (2 minutes): a chopped break, a funky mono bass, tight electric piano stabs on Dm7 and G7, a squelchy mono hook and a string pad. The drums are a sample: a two-bar break loop from the Break Loops sample pack (a rendered loop, 128 BPM, stored in the state of the Loop Slicer), cut into 16 equal slices and re-sequenced by a Pattern Tracker with the patterns of the Loop Slicer Break Chops tunes. The song tempo equals the tempo of the break, so every slice plays at its own speed; swing is 0 because the groove is in the break. Intro, build, main A, break, main B (Dm7, G7, Am7, G7) and outro. Checked on paper and with measurements only; not listened to.
